definitions.gloss: lending and borrowing; debit and credit
definitions.explanation: The combined concept of lending and borrowing, especially in financial and accounting contexts. Also used for debit and credit in bookkeeping.

examples.japanese: {貸借|たいしゃく}{対照|たいしょう}{表|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金銭|きんせん}→金銭：02684_kinsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貸借|たいしゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もとだ。
examples.english: Lending and borrowing money with friends is a source of trouble.

examples.japanese: {貸借|たいしゃく}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わして→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to exchange a contract to make the lending and borrowing relationship clear.

notes:
USAGE:
{貸借|たいしゃく} is a formal compound combining ⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧ (to lend) and ⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧ (to borrow). It is primarily used in financial, legal, and accounting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貸借|たいしゃく}{対照|たいしょう}{表|ひょう} (balance sheet — one of the most important financial statements)
- {貸借|たいしゃく}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (lending-borrowing relationship)
- ⟦{金銭|きんせん}→金銭：02684_kinsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貸借|たいしゃく} (monetary lending and borrowing)

ACCOUNTING:
In bookkeeping, {貸|かし}{方|かた} (credit side) and {借|かり}{方|かた} (debit side) are the two sides of each transaction.
